The donors' conference delivered a binding 2027 air-defense sustainment package with a partial BMD layer, and the UK tabled binding multi-year figures, though coverage of Ukraine's €70bn gap remains partial. Putin publicly matched Ukraine's restraint-register pledge with a Nov 10 deposit commitment, but mediation actors discount it given his two lapsed commitments. Congress's contested Sanctions Enforcement Integrity Act vote leaves US sanctions relief in legal limbo, while the Abu Dhabi trilateral track firms up for after Nov 10. On the ground, Russian gains stay marginal (~85 sq km since Sep 1) amid heavy attrition on both sides.

- Russian General Staff: Issue a public statement or warning (→ Ukrainian Armed Forces Command, Steve Witkoff, Donald Trump administration): "Evening summary, October 31: groupings 'Centre', 'South' and 'East' continued offensive operations in the Donetsk direction; enemy daily losses 1,715 personnel, 11 tanks, 26 field artillery pieces, 3 HIMARS launchers. Overnight, 214 Geran-2 UAVs and Iskander complexes struck military-logistics and energy facilities directly supporting the armed forces of Ukraine in 7 oblasts; all designated targets engaged. Final position before Abu Dhabi: the Federation deposits a written register of reciprocal strike calibration at the technical talks on November 10 — simultaneity with the Kiev regime's register, verified by mediators, is the only implementable formula. Unilateral pre-registration under fire from Russian regions is rejected."

Verification is exactly the standard we will apply to everyone: Moscow, Beijing, and any party that wants to trade with the peace process."
